First, I need to authenticate you. Please provide **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **First name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I verify your account, please also share your **order id** (e.g., **#W0000000**) and what changes you want (for the two watches: which options/variants you want instead).

noah_ito_3850
